title: Novig is failing (server errors)
body: Novig's servers have answered with errors for 10 minutes (ParlayAPI NFL: ParlayAPI failed for americanfootball_nfl: HTTP 502 error code: 502). The engine keeps retrying with a short wait and starts reading again by itself the moment Novig answers; the address and keys are fine. Nothing to do unless it lasts for hours.
